findings.evidence: Before asking anything, inspect the repository and any file the user gave for stack, existing behavior, and integration points.
findings.fix: Cut the opening sentence, because agents already inspect the repository on their own. Keep only the expert rule: "Never ask the user what the repository or a provided file can answer (stack, framework, current behavior). Without repository access, write your best reading as an assumption to confirm."

findings.evidence: "Identifies missing auth/context decisions" (vague-login). clarified-spec also uses "Asks about remaining boundaries or edge cases".
findings.fix: Replace these with checkable assertions. For example: "Asks about the sign-in method (password, SSO, magic link) or the account-recovery behavior" and "Asks what happens when an export exceeds 30 seconds or a team has no data".

findings.evidence: Stop asking after 3 rounds that together gained under 10 points, or after a round the user did not answer
